description: This file contains unit test cases for the CandidateJobOfferingAPI class in the OrangeHRM recruitment plugin. It tests various API endpoints such as getOne, getValidationRuleForGetOne, update, delete, and getValidationRuleForDelete, mainly verifying that unimplemented methods throw exceptions, and includes setup and data provisioning for tests.

classes.name: CandidateJobOfferingAPITest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test class for testing the CandidateJobOfferingAPI endpoints within OrangeHRM's recruitment module. It includes setup routines and specific test methods to verify the behavior and exception handling of the API methods.
